outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot; the check does not apply.
Panel B is a set of histological micrographs (H&E staining), not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel C contains a box plot (top, total polyp number per mouse) which is exempt since it already shows distribution, but also a 3D bar chart (bottom, polyp number per mouse by genotype and diameter) presenting mean values per group without any overlaid individual data points.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type that is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes blots plus a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 as mean values with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot; the check does not apply.
Panel G includes blots/zymography plus a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shown as means with error bars, without individual data points overlaid.
